annotations.title: Life chapters and phases over the years

description: Timeline of life chapters (Vimshottari Mahadashas) and phases (Antardashas, or the finer Pratyantardashas for spans up to 3 years) with start and end dates over a chosen span, marking the one running today. From birth details (free, no sign-in) or for a person saved on the user's AstroCalc account (profile; that needs a free sign-in). Use for timing questions: when a hard period ends, which coming years suit marriage or a career move, what the next decade looks like ("shaadi ka yog kab hai", "agle 10 saal"). Read-only.

from.description: Start of the span, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: 'en' (English, default) or 'hi' (Hindi).

lat.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees (north positive). Give together with lon.

lon.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees (east positive). Give together with lat.

place.description: Birth city or town, e.g. 'Lucknow' or 'Pune, Maharashtra, India'. The best match is used (Indian cities preferred); call search_place first if unsure. Not needed when lat and lon are given.

profile.description: A saved kundli on the user's AstroCalc account: its name as listed by my_profiles (e.g. 'Mummy') or its id.

time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM (e.g. '06:45', '21:10'); '6:45 am' / '9:10 PM' also work. Use 'unknown' (or omit) if not known: noon is used, the Moon sign stays reliable but the Lagna is approximate.

years.description: Length of the span in years (default 10).

name: life_timeline
title: Life chapters and phases over the years
